subject: Safe pruning of Lean package trees
principle: A file is removable only relative to an explicit supported-consumer set and evidence that the file is outside the transitive dependencies of those consumers.

current_anneal.non_mathlib_module_policy: No module-reachability deletion before fixed metadata-directory cleanup; test/ and tests/ can still remove Lean sources.

lake_v4_30_0_rc2_dependency_categories: package configuration source and compiled configuration state
dependency manifest and selected dependency graph
scripts, hooks, test/lint drivers, and extra dependency targets
compiled Lean and native artifacts required by selected targets
configured metadata paths for supported metadata/release operations
tool-specific mutable/cache state needed by supported consumers
validation_obligation: Exercise the declared supported consumer surface after pruning under the intended offline/read-only/relocated deployment conditions; fixed-name classification alone is insufficient.
not_proven: full file-access closure for every pinned transitive package
all supported generated-workspace operations after current pruning
